theorems.title: Complete favorite partner space
theorems.statement: E(qp^3)=k[p] direct-sum q k[p] direct-sum q^2 k[q^3p]
theorems.structure: Preimage of weighted Euler invariant ring k[q^3p] under second q derivative; Hilbert series(1+t)/(1-t)+t^2/(1-t^4)

theorems.title: Unique maximal dynamic Lie core
theorems.statement: A=k[p] direct-sum q k[p] is the unique largest Poisson Lie subalgebra of E(qp^3) containing H, and the full all-iterate exact core
counterexamples: q^2 exact but q^4 not exact
q^2,qp^2 exact but bracket4q^2p not exact

theorems.title: Associative rigidity
theorems.statement: G^3 in E(qp^3) implies G in k[p]; consequently k[p] is the unique maximal ordinary associative subalgebra contained in E(qp^3)

theorems.title: Finite quantum ladder criterion
theorems.statement: For H=qp^m,m>=2, and s=(c-d)/(m-1) a nonnegative integer, N=s+c: Lstar^(N+1)(q^c p^d)=0 and Lstar^N(q^c p^d)=(-(m-1))^N N! H^(star c), nonzero. Classical formula replaces star power by ordinary power.
theorems.scope: Sufficient condition; no claim of complete local-nilpotence classification
theorems.proof: Faithful localized Weyl representation, y=p^(-(m-1)), half-density gauge y^(m/(2(m-1))), polynomial coefficient derivatives.

theorems.title: Favorite finite quantum ladders
theorems.statement: For C_r, N=4r+3 and c=3r+2, exact nilpotence index is4r+4. Classical and quantum ladders terminate at H^c and H^(star c), respectively.
